_note: Week of November 2–8, 2026. Keto week 3: 20 g NET carbs per day for each of you, so every 'carbs' value in this file is net carbs (total carbs minus fiber) and the carbs goal is 20. A total-carb ceiling of 30 g per day applies this week and steps down to 28 g on November 9. One fish night (Friday) and one steak night (Wednesday). No vegetarian day and no breakfast-for-dinner. Jake has a team lunch on Thursday (no lunch container) and skips breakfast on work days. Friday is a flex day: breakfast and lunch are planned together on the Weekend tab. Jake also eats breakfast with Laine on Saturday and Sunday. Shakes use almond milk. Jake's lunch is a 3-container batch (Mon–Wed). Laine's lunches are cold jars: chicken-bacon Mon–Wed, shrimp Thursday (the second is the laineLunch2 field). No lemon or garlic flavoring, no paneer, no raw onion, mushrooms, lentils, okra, eggplant, or farro. Shopping tab is grouped by store section.

tzatziki.name: Sriracha Mayo
tzatziki.note: This week's sauce card. Used on Thursday's beef bowls (slaw and drizzle) and Laine's Thursday shrimp jar. Per-meal amounts are in each recipe. Keeps 5 days.
tzatziki.macrosNote: Per 1 tbsp serving (batch makes about 4 tbsp).

ingredients.item: Mayonnaise (avocado oil) — 3 tbsp
Sriracha — 1 tbsp
Rice vinegar — 1 tsp

steps: Stir the mayo, sriracha, and rice vinegar together until smooth.
Chill 10 min before using.

dinners.name: Pork Chops with Bacon-Dijon Cream Sauce + Buttered Zucchini
dinners.note: Cook all 780 g of pork loin tonight: 450 g is tonight's dinner and 330 g is set aside for Tuesday's wraps. Slice the loin into thick chops before searing.

ingredients.item: Pork loin — Jake 280 g, Laine 170 g
Butter — Jake 1 tbsp, Laine 2¼ tsp
Bacon, cooked — Jake 25 g, Laine 15 g
Heavy cream — Jake 3¾ tbsp, Laine 2¼ tbsp
Dijon mustard — Jake 1½ tsp, Laine 1 tsp
Yellow onion (cooked in) — Jake 10 g, Laine 8 g
Zucchini — Jake 150 g, Laine 110 g
Beef broth — Jake 20 g, Laine 15 g

steps: Pat the chops dry and season with salt and pepper. Sear in half the butter over medium-high, 3–4 min per side, until 145°F inside. Rest 5 min. Chill Tuesday's 330 g right away.
Cook the bacon pieces in the same pan until crisp, lift out, and pour off all but 1 tsp of fat. Cook the onion in the pan 2–3 min until soft.
Add the broth and scrape up the browned bits. Stir in the cream and Dijon and simmer 3–4 min until it coats a spoon. Fold the bacon back in.
Saute the zucchini in the remaining butter 4–5 min until just golden. Spoon the sauce over the pork. Jake gets the bigger portion.

dinners.name: Cubano Lettuce Wraps — Leftover Pork + Bacon + Swiss
dinners.note: Leftover Monday pork plus the treat protein: crisp bacon and Swiss. Eaten cold or warmed briefly; the pork is sliced thin. Mustard-mayo goes on every leaf.

ingredients.item: Pork loin — Jake 200 g, Laine 130 g
Bacon, cooked — Jake 25 g, Laine 15 g
Swiss cheese — Jake 40 g, Laine 30 g
Dill pickles — Jake 30 g, Laine 40 g
Romaine lettuce — Jake 110 g, Laine 90 g
Mayonnaise (avocado oil) — Jake 1¾ tbsp, Laine 1½ tbsp
Dijon mustard — Jake 2 tsp, Laine 1½ tsp
English cucumber — Jake 50 g, Laine 80 g

steps: Slice Monday's cold pork loin very thin. Warm it 1 min in a dry pan if you like.
Cook the bacon until crisp. Stir the mayo and Dijon together for the sauce.
Fill the romaine leaves with pork, Swiss, bacon, and pickle slices. Spoon the sauce over. Serve the cucumber on the side.

dinners.name: Seared Chuck Tender + Peppercorn Cream, Bacon-Roasted Cabbage & Cauliflower Mash
dinners.note: Steak night. Cook all 635 g of chuck tender tonight: 450 g for dinner and 185 g sliced and chilled for Friday's chopped salad.

ingredients.item: Chuck tender steak — Jake 280 g, Laine 170 g
Butter — Jake 1½ tbsp, Laine 1¼ tbsp
Heavy cream — Jake 4 tbsp, Laine 3¼ tbsp
Beef broth — Jake 30 g, Laine 20 g
Green cabbage, shredded — Jake 60 g, Laine 50 g
Bacon, cooked — Jake 20 g, Laine 12 g
Olive oil — Jake 1 tsp, Laine ¾ tsp
Cauliflower — Jake 90 g, Laine 80 g
Black peppercorns, cracked — 1 tsp

steps: Steam the cauliflower 8–10 min until very soft. Mash or blend with the cream, 2 tsp of the butter, salt, and pepper until smooth.
Cut the cabbage into wedges and toss with the olive oil, bacon pieces, salt, and pepper. Roast at 425°F 20 min until the edges brown.
Pat the steak dry and season with salt. Sear in the remaining butter in a very hot pan, 3–4 min per side to medium. Rest 8 min, slice against the grain, and chill Friday's 185 g.
In the same pan, simmer the broth with the cracked peppercorns 2 min, add the cream, and cook 2–3 min until thick. Spoon over the steak.

dinners.name: Sriracha-Sesame Beef Crunch Bowls
dinners.note: Heat, acid, and crunch on purpose: sriracha mayo, a quick rice-vinegar cucumber, and peanuts over the slaw. Jake has team lunch today, so tonight is the day's one cooked meal.

ingredients.item: Ground beef 85/15 — Jake 280 g, Laine 170 g
Yellow onion (cooked in) — Jake 8 g, Laine 8 g
Fresh ginger — Jake 5 g, Laine 4 g
Soy sauce — Jake 2¼ tsp, Laine 1½ tsp
Sesame oil — Jake 1¼ tsp, Laine 1 tsp
Sriracha — Jake 1¼ tsp, Laine 1 tsp
Mayonnaise (avocado oil) — Jake 1½ tbsp, Laine 1¼ tbsp
Rice vinegar — Jake 2 tsp, Laine 1½ tsp
Green cabbage, shredded — Jake 45 g, Laine 45 g
English cucumber — Jake 60 g, Laine 50 g
Peanuts, unsalted — Jake 8 g, Laine 10 g

steps: Quick-pickle the cucumber slices in the rice vinegar with a pinch of salt for 10 min.
Brown the beef with the onion and ginger, breaking it up, 7–8 min. Add the soy sauce and sesame oil and cook 1 min.
Stir the sriracha into the mayo (Sriracha Mayo card). Toss the cabbage with a spoonful of it for the slaw.
Build the bowls: slaw, beef, pickled cucumber. Drizzle with the sriracha mayo and top with the peanuts.

dinners.name: Parmesan-Almond Crusted Salmon + Dill-Dijon Cream & Sauteed Zucchini
dinners.note: The one fish night this week. The salmon is the only seafood tonight; lunch is steak.

ingredients.item: Atlantic salmon — Jake 230 g, Laine 150 g
Parmesan, grated — Jake 3 tbsp, Laine 2 tbsp
Almond flour — Jake 10 g, Laine 7 g
Mayonnaise (avocado oil) — Jake 2¼ tsp, Laine 1¾ tsp
Butter — Jake 1 tbsp, Laine 2¼ tsp
Heavy cream — Jake 2¼ tbsp, Laine 1¾ tbsp
Dijon mustard — Jake 1½ tsp, Laine 1¼ tsp
Fresh dill — Jake 3 g, Laine 2 g
Zucchini — Jake 110 g, Laine 100 g

steps: Mix the Parmesan and almond flour. Pat the salmon dry, brush the top with the mayo, and press the crumb onto it.
Bake at 425°F 10–12 min until the crust is golden and the fish flakes. Or sear in the butter, crumb side down first.
Warm the cream with the Dijon and dill in a small pan 3–4 min until it thickens. Do not boil hard.
Saute the zucchini in the butter 4–5 min until just golden. Spoon the sauce over the salmon.

dinners.name: Slow-Cooker Pulled Pork Lettuce Cups + Creamy Slaw
dinners.note: Cook 840 g of pork shoulder in the slow cooker (480 g for tonight, 360 g for Sunday's lunch bowls). No sugar in the rub.

ingredients.item: Pork shoulder — Jake 300 g, Laine 180 g
Butter — Jake 1¼ tsp, Laine 1¼ tsp
Green cabbage, shredded — Jake 70 g, Laine 80 g
Mayonnaise (avocado oil) — Jake 1¾ tbsp, Laine 1½ tbsp
Sour cream — Jake 1¼ tbsp, Laine 1 tbsp
Dijon mustard — Jake 1 tsp, Laine ¾ tsp
Cheddar cheese — Jake 30 g, Laine 25 g
Dill pickles — Jake 40 g, Laine 30 g
Romaine lettuce — Jake 60 g, Laine 50 g
Smoked paprika — 1 tsp

steps: Rub the shoulder with the smoked paprika, salt, and pepper. Slow cook on low 8 hours or high 4–5 hours until it shreds. Shred and keep the juices.
Stir the cabbage, mayo, sour cream, and Dijon together for the creamy slaw.
Fill the romaine leaves with the pork. Top with the cheddar, pickle, and slaw. Chill Sunday's pork (360 g raw weight, about 255 g cooked).

dinners.name: Bacon-Cheddar Beef Meatballs in Creamy Gravy + Cauliflower Mash
dinners.note: Cook the meatballs fresh. Cauliflower mash is Laine's favorite, so it is on the plate again tonight.

ingredients.item: Ground beef 85/15 — Jake 260 g, Laine 130 g
Almond flour — Jake 12 g, Laine 8 g
Parmesan, grated — Jake 3 tbsp, Laine 2 tbsp
Eggs — Jake 1 egg, Laine 1 egg
Yellow onion (cooked in) — Jake 10 g, Laine 8 g
Bacon, cooked — Jake 20 g, Laine 12 g
Cheddar cheese — Jake 15 g, Laine 10 g
Heavy cream — Jake 3¼ tbsp, Laine 2¾ tbsp
Beef broth — Jake 40 g, Laine 30 g
Butter — Jake 1¾ tsp, Laine 1¼ tsp
Cauliflower — Jake 90 g, Laine 80 g

steps: Mix the beef with the almond flour, Parmesan, egg, finely chopped onion, crumbled bacon, and cheddar. Roll into meatballs.
Sear the meatballs in half the butter 6–8 min, turning, until browned. Bake at 400°F 8 min if needed to finish.
Add the broth and cream to the pan and simmer 3–4 min until it makes a gravy.
Steam the cauliflower 8–10 min. Mash with the remaining butter, cream, salt, and pepper. Serve the meatballs and gravy over the mash.

jakeLunch.name: Paprika-Cream Chicken Thighs + Cauliflower Rice
jakeLunch.note: Sunday batch, 3 containers for Mon–Wed. Jake has team lunch Thursday and eats at home Friday, so nothing is prepped for those days. Chicken thighs simmered in a paprika cream sauce stay moist through reheating. No broccoli, no spinach, no fish, no lemon, no garlic. Cauliflower rice is raw-weight; steam it in the container when reheating.

ingredients.item: Chicken thighs, boneless skinless — 780 g total (260 g per container)
Heavy cream — 8 tbsp total (2¾ tbsp per container)
Sour cream — 6 tbsp total (2 tbsp per container)
Smoked paprika — 2½ tsp total (¾ tsp per container)
Yellow onion (cooked in) — 30 g total (10 g per container)
Cauliflower — 330 g total (110 g per container)
Zucchini — 120 g total (40 g per container)
Butter — 1¾ tbsp total (1¾ tsp per container)
Cheddar cheese — 60 g total (20 g per container)

steps: Pat the chicken thighs dry and season with salt and pepper. Sear in half the butter in batches, 4–5 min per side, until browned. Remove.
In the same pan, cook the onion 2–3 min until soft. Stir in the paprika for 30 seconds, then the cream and sour cream. Simmer 3–4 min.
Return the chicken to the sauce and simmer 8–10 min until cooked through (175°F for thighs). Slice or leave whole. Melt the cheddar into the sauce at the end.
Rice the cauliflower raw and slice the zucchini. Divide into 3 containers: cauliflower rice and zucchini on one side, chicken with plenty of sauce on the other. Reheat with a splash of water.

laineLunch.name: Chicken-Bacon Crunch Jar (Mon–Wed)
laineLunch.note: Cold chicken salad over crunchy romaine, no reheating. Poach the chicken Sunday, chill, and chop. Dressing goes on the bottom; romaine on top. Made for 3 jars: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday.

ingredients.item: Chicken breast — 315 g total (105 g per jar)
Bacon, cooked — 36 g total (12 g per jar)
Mayonnaise (avocado oil) — 4¾ tbsp total (1½ tbsp per jar)
Dijon mustard — 2½ tsp total (¾ tsp per jar)
Celery — 90 g total (30 g per jar)
Pecans — 30 g total (10 g per jar)
Romaine lettuce — 210 g total (70 g per jar)
English cucumber — 150 g total (50 g per jar)
Cheddar cheese — 45 g total (15 g per jar)

steps: Sunday: poach the chicken breast in salted water 12–14 min until 165°F. Chill and chop. Cook the bacon crisp and crumble.
Stir the chicken with the mayo, Dijon, celery, pecans, and bacon.
Layer each jar: chicken salad on the bottom, then cucumber, cheddar, and romaine on top.
Keep cold. Tip into a bowl to eat.

laineLunch2.name: Cold Shrimp Crunch Jar (Thu)
laineLunch2.note: Uses the shrimp already in the freezer. Cold and crunchy, no reheating, with a sriracha-mayo dressing. One jar for Thursday.

ingredients.item: Shrimp (frozen, raw) — 110 g
Romaine lettuce — 80 g
English cucumber — 50 g

Dijon mustard — ¾ tsp
Sriracha — ¾ tsp
Pecans — 6 g
Bacon, cooked — 8 g
Butter — 1 tsp

steps: Wednesday night: thaw the shrimp in the fridge. Saute in the butter 2–3 min until pink, cool, and chill. Crumble the bacon.
Stir the mayo, Dijon, and sriracha together for the dressing.
Layer the jar: dressing and shrimp on the bottom, then celery, cucumber, cheddar, pecans, bacon, and romaine on top.
Keep cold. Tip into a bowl to eat.
